svg.title: Long-input waiting and concurrent completion
svg.desc: The 131,072-token input waited 202.74 seconds for first output and finished in 543.40 seconds. The 516,031-token input waited 897.37 seconds and finished in 1,267.89 seconds. Four shorter requests completed at 51.84 aggregate tokens per second; near-full input plus three shorter companions completed at 49.91, including prefill. Individual requests are split into time before first output and remaining request time. The other panel reports whole-batch output tokens per second including prefill and scheduling. Every request produced 8,192 tokens; each batch produced 32,768. Cases and batches ran once, with prefix reuse permitted. The mixed batch followed the individual near-full request; four fresh maximum-length histories were not tested.
